title: No malls, but a fishing village
content: I have never actually dreamt about a literal mall. However, I have dreamt about spaces that seemed very real and stand out to me. One being a small fishing village on the edge of a river that was off a road in the town I lived in (The road didn’t actually exist). In the village was a café that I went to. I dreamt about this place several times. Also, I’ve had a few dreams of a night-time airport/gas station/activity building and what I mostly remember was the blue light. I’ve seen some similar places described here. I just joined this sub because I love dream imagery and resonated with people revisiting places in their dreams that feel very real. Thank you for letting me be a part of it.
